title: CVAS: Contribution, Verification and Assurance System (Cloud Source Harness)
description:
CVAS is a project-independent contribution, verification and assurance harness. A contributor, human or AI, supplies a bounded component with a manifest, an implementation, a test suite and a mutation test; the harness validates the archive and the manifest, runs the tests within time limits, records evidence with hashes, and routes the change by risk class (A, B or C) to the review it needs. It is web-first: a static site, a JavaScript verifier, and a browser-only Google Colab workflow, with Python retained for Python components.

This alpha release is CVAS iteration 8. Files changed when the repository was seeded are listed in origin/SEED-DIFF.md, with each original kept under origin/.
